tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi bskang ba dang bshags pa dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi bskang ba dang bshags pa dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi bskang ba dang bshags pa dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru ya mān+ta kā ya/ 'dir sgrub pa pos 'jam dpal ya mān+ta ka'i thugs dam bskang zhing nyams chag bshag par bya ba ni/ 'don cha dang mtshungs pa'i phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i bskang rdzas rnams dngos su 'byor ba rnams bshams shing*/ ma 'byor ba yid kyis yang dag par sprul la/ gtor mar sha zan sman raka bsgron la/ yo byad rnams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba bid+yā pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā warta ya ā warta ya hoḥ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs pas/ dngos 'byor nam mkha'i khams gang bar mos la/ 'di skad do// hūm̐ e/ 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing khams nas// drag po e yi gzhal yas dam pa nas// rab 'jigs khro rgyal phyag rgya zil gnon dang*// yum sras sprul pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// rnal 'byor gdung ba'i yid kyis spyan 'dren na// dam tshig smon lam dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs// gshin rje pho mo ma he chu glang dang*// sna tshogs pad zla nyi ma'i gdan steng du// mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol// gnyis med gus pa'i tshul gyis phyag 'tshal lo// phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin nyid dang ni// sman raka gtor tshogs mchod pa 'bul gyis bzhes// dam tshig nyams chag 'gal 'khrul nongs pa bshags// dus gsum 'khor 'das dge la rjes yi rangs/ */gang 'dul der ston theg gsum dam pa'i chos// bla med 'khor lo rab tu bskor bar bskul// sems can khams rnams ji srid ma grol bar// mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par bzhugs su gsol| |'khor 'das dus gsum bsags yod dge ba'i tshogs// 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo bar bgyi// e/ lha mchog ya mān+ta ka 'khor bcas kyi// dgyes pa bskyed cing thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir// ar+ghaṃ me tog bdug spos mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo gzugs sgra dri ro dang*// reg bya rgyal srid bdun dang bkra shis kyi// rtags dang rdzas brgyad lha rdzas spyan gzigs sogs// 'dod pa'i yon tan ma tshang med pa ni// phyi yi mchod pa dngos 'byor yid sprul bas// 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon thugs dam bskang*// yum mchog ma mo khrag mig thugs dam bskang*// sras mchog ya ma rā tsa'i thugs dam bskang*// sku sprul 'chi bdag nag po'i thugs dam bskang*// gsung sprul srog bdag nag po'i dmar po/

thugs dam bskang*// las kyi gshin rje'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang*// ma mo'i dmag tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// sde brgyad dmag tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// 'chi bdag bye ba sa ya'i thugs dam bskang*// srog bdag bye ba sa ya'i thugs dam bskang*// 'khor gyi dregs pa'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang*// dmar chen ar+ghaṃ mchod pa mtsho ltar bskyil// dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog gcal du bkram// sha chen gu gul sreg spos sprin ltar gtibs// tshil chen mar me'i snang ba nyi ltar gsal// mkhris sbyar dri chab ngad ldan kun nas gtams// sha rus 'bru nag zhal zas ri ltar spungs// rdza rnga rkang gling rol mo 'brug ltar sgrog /nang gi mchod pa dngos 'byor yid sprul pas// 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon thugs dam bskang*// yum mchog ma mo khrag mig thugs dam bskang*// sras mchog ya ma rā tsa'i thugs dam bskang*// sku sprul 'chi bdag nag po'i thugs dam bskang*| |gsung sprul srog bdag nag po'i dmar po/ thugs dam bskang*// las kyi gshin rje'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang*// ma mo'i dmag tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// sde brgyad dmag tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// 'chi bdag bye ba sa ya'i thugs dam bskang*// srog bdag bye ba sa ya'i thugs dam bskang*// 'khor gyi dregs pa'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang*// pad+ma can sogs phyag rgya rnam pa lnga/ /sbyor sgrol yum chen khro mo'i skur gyur nas// 'du shes gsum ldan dga' bde'i snyoms 'jug gi// dga' dang mchog dga' dga' bral lhan skyes bzhi// lugs 'byung lugs ldog 'dzag med chags bral ba// gsang mchod dam pa rmad byung 'khyud sbyor gyis// 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon thugs dam bskang*| |yum mchog ma mo khrag mig thugs dam bskang*// sras mchog ya ma rā tsa'i thugs dam bskang*// sku sprul 'chi bdag nag po'i thugs dam bskang*// gsung sprul srog bdag nag po'i dmar po/

thugs dam bskang*// las kyi gshin rje'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang*// ma mo'i dmag tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// sde brgyad dmag tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// 'chi bdag bye ba sa ya'i thugs dam bskang*// srog bdag bye ba sa ya'i thugs dam bskang*// 'khor gyi dregs pa'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang*// 'khor 'das mnyam nyid ye klong gdod nas dag /lha dang bdag sogs gnyis med sems kyi rtsal// du mar snang yang chos nyid ngo bor gcig /mchod bya mchod byed bskang bya skong byed sogs// gnyis med mnyam rol ye shes dbyings kyi ngang*// de bzhin nyid kyi mchod pa bla med 'dis// 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon thugs dam bskang*// yum mchog ma mo khrag mig thugs dam bskang*// sras mchog ya ma rā tsa'i thugs dam bskang*// sku sprul 'chi bdag nag po'i thugs dam bskang*// gsung sprul srog bdag nag po'i dmar po/ thugs dam bskang*// las kyi gshin rje'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang*// ma mo'i dmag tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// sde brgyad dmag tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// 'chi bdag bye ba sa ya'i thugs dam bskang*// srog bdag bye ba sa ya'i thugs dam bskang*// 'khor gyi dregs pa'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang*// rtsa brgyad stong sbyar 'chi med a mṛ ta| |'bru bcud myos byed kyis sbyangs sman gyi mchog /rgyu rkyen snod bcud baṃ chen ru dhī ra// mchog chen khrag dang sbyar ba'i dmar chen po// dam rdzas gtor ma brjid ldan dkar dmar brgyan| |bza' btung thabs shes tshogs kyi 'khor lo sogs// khyad par rmad du byung ba'i dam rdzas kyis// 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon thugs dam bskang*// yum mchog ma mo khrag mig thugs dam bskang*// sras mchog ya ma rā tsa'i thugs dam bskang*// sku sprul 'chi bdag nag po'i thugs dam bskang*// gsung sprul srog bdag nag po'i dmar po/

thugs dam bskang*| |las kyi gshin rje'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang*// ma mo'i dmag tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// sde brgyad dmag tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// 'chi bdag bye ba sa ya'i thugs dam bskang*// srog bdag bye ba sa ya'i thugs dam bskang*// 'khor gyi dregs pa'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang*// hūm̐ */ gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba ni// gnas kyi dam tshig yin pa'i phyir// brag nag bya skyibs mkhar chen dang*// dur khrod 'bar bas thugs dam bskang*// gnyen po'i dam tshig yin pa'i phyir// 'jam dpal zhi khro'i thugs dam bskang*| |mthun pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// mon dang rta nag bya rog snying*// keng rus gtor mas thugs dam bskang*// phyi yi rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// khram shing nag po ba glang nag |be shing 'khar bas thugs dam bskang*// nang gi rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// thod pa dang ni dur khrod ras// yi dwags grong gis thugs dam bskang*// gsang ba'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// sgrub rdzas gnyan pos thugs dam bskang*// sku yi rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// ro ras bris skus thugs dam bskang*// gsung gi rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir| |gsang sngags 'dzab kyis thugs dam bskang*// thugs kyi rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// ting 'dzin rdo rjes thugs dam bskang*// yon tan rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// 'dod yon tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang*// phrin las rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// phur thun mtshon chas thugs dam bskang*// bla rdo'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// sbur len rat+nas thugs dam bskang*// gcun pa'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// skyer phur 'bar bas thugs dam bskang*// bcing ba'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// lcags kyi ga'us thugs dam bskang*// gzir ba'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir| |gri rgod khrag gis thugs dam bskang*// bsrung ba'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// sku gdung 'bar bas thugs dam bskang*// bzlog pa'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// 'khrul 'khor drag pos thugs dam bskang*// bsad pa'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// pū ri e yis thugs dam bskang*// bsgral ba'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// gri lcags ngar mas thugs dam bskang*// brdeg pa'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// sna tshogs thun gyis thugs dam bskang*// gdab pa'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// phur bu gsum gyis thugs dam bskang*// dbye ba'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// bya rog 'ug pas thugs dam bskang*// bsreg pa'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// gdug pa me yis thugs dam bskang*// 'phang ba'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// drag po zor gyis thugs dam bskang*// mnan gtad rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// klu dbang thod pa khyu ba'i rwa// drag po'i rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang*// 'bod pa'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// bshug pa'i sgra yis thugs dam bskang*// g.yab pa'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// gri lag g.yab mos thugs dam bskang*// sgra yi rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// rdza rnga 'bar bas thugs dam bskang*// gyon pa'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// yi dwags gos kyis thugs dam bskang*// 'chang ba'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// mchog gi phur bus thugs dam bskang*// thogs pa'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir| |be seng 'khar bas thugs dam bskang*// bza' ba'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// sha lnga bdud rtsis thugs dam bskang*// btung ba'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// khrag chen dri chus thugs dam bskang*// gdengs pa'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// be con 'bar bas thugs dam bskang*// 'ding ba'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// dom chen pags pas thugs dam bskang*// cod pan rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// ral pa muñjas thugs dam bskang*// brten pa'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// rten gtor chen pos thugs dam bskang*// mchod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// mchod gtor bzang pos thugs dam bskang*// rtags kyi dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// rtags gtor 'bar bas thugs dam bskang*// pho rgyud tshogs rnams mnyes pa'i phyir// 'bru bcud chang gis thugs dam bskang*// mo rgyud tshogs rnams mnyes pa'i phyir// rak+ta dmar gyis thugs dam bskang*// klu rgyud tshogs rnams mnyes pa'i phyir// dkar mngar sman gyis thugs dam bskang*// yab yum sras sprul 'khor dang bcas// so sor dgyes pa bskyed pa'i phyir// mkha' lding nag po gser mig dang*// shel sgong nag po spyi dkar dang*// tsa ra rog po mdangs ldan dang*// mchog chen mchog phran ma he glang*// sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga// brtan g.yo'i longs spyod mkho dgur bcas// rang rang dgyes shing mthun pa'i rdzas// dngos 'byor yid sprul mtha' yas pas// gnam sa bar snang yongs bskangs bas// 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang*// phyag rgya zil gnon thugs dam bskang*| |mkha' lding khyung gi thugs dam bskang*// ma mo khrag mig thugs dam bskang*// ya ma rā tsa'i thugs dam bskang*// 'chi bdag nag po'i thugs dam bskang*// srog bdag nag po'i dmar po/

thugs dam bskang*// las kyi gshin rje'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang*// ma mo'i dmag tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// sde brgyad dmag tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// 'chi bdag dmag tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// srog bdag dmag tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// dregs pa'i dmag tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*| |'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang*// khyod kyi thugs dam bskangs bar bgyis// sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag 'bul// da bcol sgrub pa'i gnyer zas 'bul// phyis bcol snyan gsan zhu skyems 'bul// bskang ngo bskal pa'i thugs dam bskang*// rnal 'byor g.yar dam bskang du gsol// phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod// hūm̐ */ bskang ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis bskang*// mchod du med de khams gsum yongs kyis mchod// sbyor du med de khams gsum yongs kyis sbyor// sgrol du med de khams gsum yongs kyis sgrol// ye sbyor ye sgrol chen pos thugs dam bskang*// hūm̐ */ dngos po chos nyid yangs pa'i klong du bskang*// snang ba ye shes chen po'i klong du bskang*| |gsal ba shes rab 'bar ba'i klong du bskang*// sdug bsngal ka dag chos nyid klong du bskang*// kun rdzob don dam gnyis med klong du bskang*// skong gyur dbang dang dngos grub bstsal du gsol// ma hā sid+dhi sa ma ya a la la hoḥ zhes bskang*/ bshags pa ni/ hūm̐ */ 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon yab dang yum// sras sprul dregs pa'i dmag tshogs bdag la dgongs| |khams gsum sems can rnams kyi don slad du// bdag ni bla med byang chub sgrub sems kyang*// ma rig nga bdag 'khrul blo bag med dang*// rnam g.yeng gnyid dang snyoms las dbang gyur pas// lha mchog khyod dang mchog gsum skyabs gnas su// khas blangs bgyis kyang de yi dam la 'gal// byang chub sems gnyis bsgom par dam bcas kyang*// de yi rtsa ba yan lag bsrung mtshams nyams// gsang sngags rdo rje mchog tu dam mnos kyang*// dbang bzhi'i dam tshig so sor gsungs rnams dang*// rtsa ltung bcu bzhi sbom brgyad yan lag ni| |bzhi bcu dang ni phra mo 'bum phrag dang*// khyad par 'jam dpal khro bo'i gsang rgyud sogs// 'jam dpal gshin rje'i rgyud nas gsungs pa yi// khyad par bsrung ba nyer gcig lhag pa gsum// thun mong nyer brgyad khyad par bcu bzhi sogs// ji snyed gsungs rnams yal bar dor ba dang*// lha mchog khyod bsten sgrub par dam bcas nas// sku yi phyag rgya mtshan nyid gsum dang 'gal// gsung gi bzlas brjod tshul bdun nyams pa dang*// grangs dus rtags kyi bsnyen sgrub tshad ma phebs// thugs kyi ting 'dzin 'khrul g.yeng dri mas bsgribs// yon tan sman raka mchod gtor tshogs rdzas sogs// phud nyams ma tshang rgyu chung lhag ma 'dres// 'bags btsog gis bsgribs des 'ong des chog gam// phrin las sbyor sgrol dus las 'das pa dang*// srung zlog bsad pa'i mtshan nyid ma rdzogs dang*// sreg 'phang mnan pa'i sbyor kha log pa dang*// las sbyor tshad thal skyengs dred 'dzol ba dang*// ral gcod gzu lum spyi brtol rang bzos bslad// gzhan yang dang du blang dang spong ba dang*// bsrung dang bza' dang bsten dang shes pa sogs// dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang 'gal ba dang*// kun kyang chos nyid don las g.yel ba sogs// kun rdzob don dam bsrung mtshams ji snyed las// 'gal zhing nyams pas gnas skabs sdug bsngal zhing*// mthar thug byang chub thob la bsgribs pa dang*// 'phral dang yun gyi nyes tshogs sdig sgrib rgyun// tshor dang ma tshor ma shes nongs pa dang*// shes bzhin khyad du bsad pa la sogs pa// bdag rmongs ma rung 'gal bar gang gyur pa// gnong ngo 'gyod do dam can srung ma'i tshogs// mthol lo bshags so bzod tshangs deng bzhes shig

/phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi bgyi yi// sngon chad nyams la 'gyod cing bshags zin gyi// phyin chad mi bgyid sdom par dam bca' na// bdag 'dod 'bras bu yongs su grub par mdzod// bskangs kyang mi skong bshags kyang mi 'tshal bar| |sngags 'chang bdag la srung mas khro bgyid na// sngon gyi dam tshig tshogs dang mi 'gal lam// ye shes lha la khro ba mi mnga' yang*// dregs pa'i tshogs rnams gtum zhing ma rungs pas// ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas rjes dgongs la// dngos grub rnam gnyis 'bras bu 'dir stsol cig /ces dang*/ ya ma rā dza'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum sogs brjod do// de ltar sngags 'chang rnal 'byor pa'i dam tshig nyams chag bskang zhing bshags pa 'di'ang*/ 'jam dpal yang zlog me'i spu gri'i nyer mkhor sbyar ba yin gyi/ 'di nyid bsnyen sgrub/ gzhi bsnyen/ dus gtor/ tshogs la sogs kyi skabs bya'i/ srung zlog bsad mnan las sbyor sgrub pa'i skabs nan gyis sbyar dgos pa ni ma yin no// zhes pa'ang 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas me glang zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gcig la gdan sa chen po dpal gyi 'bri gung chos phyug gi klung du sbyar ba dge// //shu bhaṃ stu/ sarba dza ga taṃ maṅga laṃ//
